svg.title: NumSharp integrations
svg.desc: NumSharp in the center, with a data stream out to each integration: NumPy, PyTorch, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Pillow, OpenCV, PyArrow, polars, ONNX Runtime, ML.NET, System.Numerics.Tensors, TorchSharp, System.Drawing, Numpy.NET, OpenBLAS, .npy / .npz.
